messages.content: Can you walk me through how a subscription billing cycle actually works?

Sure - when someone subscribes, they're charged immediately for the first period, and that date becomes their recurring billing anchor. Every subsequent cycle (usually monthly) they're charged automatically on that same date unless they cancel first. If they cancel, they keep access until the current paid period ends, they just don't get charged again after that. If a payment fails, most platforms retry a few times over several days before suspending access - it's rarely an instant cutoff on the first failed attempt.
